patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
Many customers find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
The restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment is often described negatively.
Customers express general dissatisfaction with aspects not covered by other categories.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, poor ingredient sourcing, or lack of quality control.

root_causes.pattern: Many customers find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
root_causes.cause: Overpricing relative to perceived value, or high operational costs passed to customers.

root_causes.pattern: The restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment is often described negatively.
root_causes.cause: Poor interior design, lack of maintenance, uncomfortable seating, or undesirable noise levels.

root_causes.pattern: Customers express general dissatisfaction with aspects not covered by other categories.
root_causes.cause: Unspecified operational shortcomings, unmet expectations, or issues not fitting standard categories.
